title: One free week, then the store charges

steps.label:
Subscribes in the store with a card on file.
Pays nothing; the whole app is open.
Still free. Can cancel in the store any time.

The store charges, unless they cancelled.
No free tier and no Pro tier to fall back to.
No second trial for the same person.

example: Example: subscribes 1 Oct, free to 7 Oct,
first charge 8 Oct. The store keeps the clock.
